timeline.summary: On 20 April 2026, Kirloskar Industries reported that NSE admitted its listed material subsidiary Kirloskar Ferrous Industries (KIRLFER) to trading on the Capital Market Segment from that date.
Kirloskar Industries notified that material subsidiary Kirloskar Ferrous Industries set its NCLT merger hearing for May 15, 2026.
Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited (KFIL) filed intimation under SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015, on 2026-05-05 via Ashwini Mali, Kirloskar Industries Limited.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,827.41 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹44.26 Cr.
On May 7, 2026, material subsidiary Kirloskar Ferrous Industries allotted 52,900 ESOP shares and approved seeking member approval to raise up to ₹1,000 Cr via NCDs.

On 8 May 2026, Kirloskar Industries filed material subsidiary KFIL's Q4FY26 investor presentation: standalone FY26 revenue ₹6,784 Cr, EBITDA ₹836 Cr at 12.3% margin, Q4 PAT ₹130.0 Cr, gross debt ₹1,034 Cr and net debt/EBITDA 1.14x.
On May 16, 2026, Kirloskar Industries filed material subsidiary KFIL's Q4FY26 earnings call transcript detailing volume growth targets and capex plans.
Jyotsna Kulkarni, promoter of Kirloskar Industries Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares held by her promoter group as of March 31, 2026.
On May 26, 2026, Kirloskar Industries informed the exchange about a newspaper notice published by its subsidiary KFIL regarding IEPF share transfers.

On 3 June 2026, Kirloskar Industries reported that NCLT Mumbai approved, by order of 2 June 2026, the merger of wholly owned subsidiaries Oliver Engineering and Adicca Energy Solutions into material subsidiary KFIL, with no shares issued and the transferors dissolved without winding up.
2026-10-17: Kirloskar Industries informed exchanges that its material subsidiary Kirloskar Ferrous Industries resumed operations at the Hiriyur plant mini blast furnace on October 16, 2026.
